name: Hellivery
storyline: Loopy was just a simple, overworked deliveryman. Tired of his boring life stuck in a never-ending cycle of deliveries. After a car accident while on duty, he woke up in Hell. Now he’s stuck delivering doughnuts to hungry demons for eternity, making one delivery after the other while trying to survive the local fauna.
summary: Experience every deliveryman's personal hell, being stuck in an endless shift with terrible working conditions. Deliver doughnuts to hungry demons and avoid obstacles along the way.
